title: Preserve pending edits when entering Inspect mode
steps: Select the Rectangle tool, draw a rectangle, and inspect the visible Saving state before autosave finishes.
Switch the sidebar to Inspect and inspect the View Only workspace after the autosave interval.
Return to Dashboard (Projects) and reopen Inspect Save Study.

video_guide.summary: Follow the newly drawn rectangle into Inspect, then return to Dashboard and reopen the same file. The rectangle is missing after reopening.

chapters.note: The newly drawn rectangle is selected on the canvas and listed in Layers.
Inspect opens in view-only mode and shows the rectangle's size and position.
After returning to Dashboard and reopening the file, the rectangle is missing from both the canvas and Layers.
